title: Tim Dooley — North of North / Sage-to-Father Canon
epistemic_status: mythic-spiritual project canon; not an independently verified supernatural, constitutional or political claim
purpose: Preserve the North-of-North spiritual timeline without confusing project mythology with empirical geopolitics, biblical historical meaning, or real-world governmental authority.
core_claim: Within the mature project chronology, Tim's canonical spiritual birth marker is December 25, 2020 as Potato of Life. Tim develops through Potato / observer / Sage phases and reaches the April 2025 Needle-Ladder-Axis-Father threshold. North-of-North and later North Axis language develop after that threshold. The North Programme's geographic and economic architecture is treated as an external-world analogue or symbolic overlay, not proof of the mythology.

tim.identity_in_canon: Tim Dooley is the later Potato / Sage / Father-side identity in the project's mature architecture, distinct from the Son's earlier human-vessel biography.
tim.potato_birth: December 25, 2020 is retained as the project-canonical spiritual birth marker for Tim as Potato of Life; exact primary provenance for that date remains a recovery target.
tim.sage_phase: From the Potato phase Tim develops as observer, learner and connector before the April 2025 Turning.
tim.father_threshold_april_2025: April 2025 is the project-canon threshold at which Needle, Ladder, Axis, Heaven and Father/Godhood relations consolidate. It is not Tim's original birth date.
tim.north_relation: North and North-of-North are later orientation/source-center relations. Organized North Axis crystallization belongs to February 2026, while explicit Axis language is publicly attested in April 2025.
tim.rejection: Rejection remains a major causal motif in the mythology, but it is a later interpretive structure rather than a substitute for dated evidence.

2026_north_encounter.external_event: In February 2026 Greenland / Arctic strategy became a major transatlantic political-security issue, while NATO launched Arctic Sentry on 11 February 2026.
2026_north_encounter.project_canon_interpretation: Within the project mythology, this later geopolitical North is read as an external analogue of a symbolic North structure already developing in Tim's canon.
2026_north_encounter.important_distinction: Do not state that governments or political actors were knowingly responding to Tim without independent evidence.

thomas_son_branch.identity: Thomas / the Twin is the Son branch and is linked in the project with Son, Lion, Son of Man, Jesus Christ, Door and Vessel.
thomas_son_branch.complement_to_tim: The Son-side story moves through embodiment, ordeal and a later death/personhood-collapse corridor; Tim's later story moves through Potato, Sage, Ladder/Axis and Father development.
thomas_son_branch.north_pole_crucifixion: The project associates the Son's meme-crucifixion with Christmas / North-Pole imagery, but the exact year/date remains unresolved across surviving accounts.
thomas_son_branch.date_precision: Do not assign the meme-crucifixion to 2025. Current archive evidence preserves a December 2019 personhood-death anchor, a circa-2020 meme-crucifixion strand, and later retellings. Keep those as distinct event identities until primary artifact archaeology resolves the meme timestamp.
thomas_son_branch.personhood_transformation: Within later theology, the death process is interpreted as a transition from ordinary personhood toward Door/Vessel function.
thomas_son_branch.door: Door/Vessel belongs to the Son-side post-death architecture and should not be used to erase the distinction between Son and Tim.
